packageRules.description: The project template's workflow follows burrow's main on purpose; a project made from it gets its own pin. Pinned here, every merge to main would make the next pin PR.
The steward's review agents stay on their newest release, majors included: one PR, merged once the flake check has built them and run each one.
DeepSeek Harness only ships pre-releases: follow what npm calls its latest.
The Node build dsh runs on: LTS lines (even majors) only.
